title: scans into open questions
description: User story under REQ-187. The intake scans run inside `brief add --from` over the new statements against every existing statement, and every finding becomes an openQuestion statement with source `scan:<name>:<ids>`.
iWant: contradictions and gaps the tool can see to reach me as questions
soThat: the first readiness run tells me what is still mine

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given two new statements the contradiction scan flags, when brief add --from runs with scans on, then one openQuestion statement is appended with source scan:contradiction:<id>,<id> and brief:openQuestions fails it.
[happy] given a --findings file with two findings, when brief add --from runs, then two openQuestion statements are appended with source scan:<name>.
[happy] given a frozen tree, when brief add --from runs, then the scans compare the new statements against every existing statement.
[happy] given --json, when brief add --from runs, then stdout holds added[] and findings[].
[failure] given --no-scan together with --findings, when brief add runs, then it exits 2.
[must-not] given --text, when brief add runs, then no scan runs and no openQuestion statement is appended.
